title: Local embedding model
requirement: Provide one open-weight embedding model for retrieval over code, documents and agent session text, served locally on the host's GPU or CPU through an OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Retrieval quality on public text and code retrieval benchmarks at the same dimension budget, throughput and memory on the host, and maximum input length.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
